name: Sneha Malhotra
text: Went alone, came back with 14 people who feel like family. Captain Tenzin noticed I was struggling on the Kheerganga climb before I did. That's the whole review.

name: arjun.treks
text: 6 group trips with other companies before this. Tripwaley is the only one where the itinerary wasn't fiction. Summit at 6:40 AM, exactly as promised. 🏔️

name: Priya Kulkarni
text: Boarding from Jaipur instead of travelling to Delhi first saved us a whole day. Volvo was clean, on time, and the hotel was actually the one from the photos.

name: Rohit Sharma
text: My mother tracked the live location the whole week and has now booked HERSELF a batch. Four stars only because the bus aux cable was contested territory.

name: diya.wanders
text: Tungnath at sunrise had me crying into my maggi. Zero planning stress — they literally message you what to pack, when to sleep, when to wake up.

name: Kabir Anand
text: Solo travellers: just go. 72% of our batch was solo. By day two 'solo' stops being a category. Baralacha La with this crew was unreal.

name: farhan_shoots
text: Saw the Milky Way from Tosh. Quit my gym. Unrelated. The captain's chai > any café in Kasol. 📸 shot on the trip, no edits.

name: Nikita Rao
text: Women-only dorm option, women captain on request, live location for family. I've recommended Tripwaley to my entire office. Mum-approved — highest tier.
